description: This file defines an SMTP class implementing RFC 821 SMTP protocol functions for connecting, authenticating, and sending emails via SMTP servers.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: A class providing methods to connect, authenticate, and communicate with SMTP servers for email transmission.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified SMTP server and port.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication with username and password.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Sends email data (headers and body) to the SMTP server.

methods.name: Hello
methods.description: Sends HELO/EHLO command to initialize SMTP session.

methods.name: Quit
methods.description: Terminates the SMTP session and closes the connection.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies if a given email address or name is recognized by the server.
